Do you mean the Drivers' World Championship or the Constructors' Championship — and for which season/year?

Note: my training goes up to June 2024. The most recent completed season I can confirm is 2023: Drivers' champion — Max Verstappen (Red Bull); Constructors' champion — Red Bull Racing. If you mean the 2024 (or 2025) title, I don't have live updates — would you like me to look it up for you now?
